summary: Remembers where you gather herbs, ore, fish, treasure and quest objects, and shows those places on the world map and the minimap.
description: Forever Gather learns from your own gathering. Each time you pick an herb, mine a vein, fish, open a chest or open a quest object, it remembers the place and the name of the node. Those places show on the world map and on the minimap, with an icon for each kind. You choose which kinds show, and can hide nodes that your skill has outgrown. It can say when a node that you know is near, shows what each node gave, and counts the gathers of a session. The data comes from your own characters; you can pass it to another player as text. Type /fgather for commands.
